classification: gate-scope clarification (reporting-scope layer). Freezes the applicability scope of the frozen rejection_rate <= 0.50 scientific gate to formal IID only, and classifies the candidate rejection rate of targeted formal OOD rejection sampling as a PROPOSAL_EFFICIENCY_DIAGNOSTIC rather than a population-quality gate. Does NOT touch any scientific predicate, support bound, token rule, physical guard, seed root, block definition, quota, total, proposal parameter, or gate threshold value.

scope_ruling.ruling: IID-only rejection gate: the frozen rejection_rate <= 0.50 scientific gate applies ONLY to formal IID (per_stratum and overall); it does NOT apply to targeted formal OOD rejection sampling
scope_ruling.rejected_option: option 1 (constructing an 'OOD scientific rejection rate that excludes SUPPORT_BOUND dispositions') is REJECTED: the mechanical/scientific rejection distinction is unstable for conditional OOD sampling
scope_ruling.proposal_retuning_ban: this is a gate-scope clarification only; proposal samplers, quotas, blocks, seeds, physical guards and thresholds are NOT retuned

iid_rejection_gate_retained.applies_to: formal IID only: all 9 strata (per_stratum) and the pooled overall rate
iid_rejection_gate_retained.computation_source: the AMENDMENT_03 allocator consumption ledger (canonical ascending per-stratum/condition candidate consumption over the frozen 1000-index blocks); rejection rate = rejections / consumed candidates per stratum and pooled overall
iid_rejection_gate_retained.semantics: formal IID draws represent the preregistered population distribution; a high rejection rate under ascending consumption means the preregistered IID support itself cannot sustain the quota, i.e. a population-distribution quality failure
iid_rejection_gate_retained.failure_consequence: any per_stratum or overall violation => IID_REJECTION_GATE FAIL => STOP (no auto-relaxation, no denominator redefinition)

ood_sampling_semantics.method: targeted conditional rejection sampling under preregistered proposal samplers (A1/B1 truncated-normal proposals; C1/C2/C3 natural sampling per host regime frozen distributions + canonical REQUIRE predicate)
ood_sampling_semantics.candidate_rejection_rate_semantics: PROPOSAL_EFFICIENCY_DIAGNOSTIC: measures how efficiently the frozen proposal concentrates candidates inside the condition's acceptance region; it is NOT a population-distribution quality gate and carries NO threshold
ood_sampling_semantics.gate_application_ban: the frozen <= 0.50 rejection gate SHALL NOT be applied to OOD conditions A1/B1/C1/C2/C3 (neither per-condition nor pooled)
ood_sampling_semantics.excluded_construction_ban: constructing an 'OOD scientific rejection rate excluding SUPPORT_BOUND dispositions' (option 1) is FORBIDDEN: the mechanical/scientific rejection split is unstable for conditional OOD
ood_sampling_semantics.transparency_requirement: the disposition breakdown MUST be reported transparently for every OOD condition: ACCEPT, SUPPORT_BOUND-target-miss, GUARD_BAND, NO_TARGET, STRESS_SET, FAILED_* (per the frozen same-seed retry policy), and any other frozen disposition class

a1_smoke_evidence.role: worked example: an allocation that is LEGAL formal OOD output under this ruling
a1_smoke_evidence.verdict: COMPATIBLE_WITH_LEGAL_FORMAL_OOD_ALLOCATION: a ~93.9% proposal rejection rate is the expected behavior of a targeted conditional proposal near the IID support boundary and does NOT constitute any gate failure; OOD validity is decided by the five hard gates G1-G5 below, never by the proposal-efficiency diagnostic

ood_hard_gates.validity_basis: OOD sample validity is decided exclusively by these five gates; none of them is a rejection-rate gate

G1_exact_quota.name: G1 exact quota
G1_exact_quota.semantics: every OOD condition fills EXACTLY its preregistered quota of 10 accepted families (40 voyages); automatic derating, quota reduction, or partial fills are FORBIDDEN

G2_frozen_block_reachability.name: G2 frozen-block reachability
G2_frozen_block_reachability.semantics: UNREACHABLE is emitted only when the ENTIRE frozen 1000-index block of the condition is consumed (AMENDMENT_03 ascending consumption) with the quota still unfilled; a high number of rejections or a low proposal yield alone NEVER constitutes UNREACHABLE

G3_predicate_purity.name: G3 predicate purity
G3_predicate_purity.semantics: scientific membership is judged on realized values under the frozen condition predicates; near-miss candidates MUST NOT enter the accepted corpus

G4_physical_domain.name: G4 physical-domain
G4_physical_domain.semantics: STRESS_SET candidates are excluded from the formal OOD corpus (700 kW propulsion capacity at 11 kn adverse; hard bounds |U|<=2.8, ht>=1.3; guard bands — all unchanged); the FREQUENCY of STRESS_SET removals is diagnostic-only with NO threshold

G5_accounting_and_reproducibility.name: G5 accounting closure + worker-count invariance + same-plan two runs
G5_accounting_and_reproducibility.semantics: every consumed candidate carries exactly one final ledger disposition (AMENDMENT_03 candidate_accounting_closure); the allocation plan is bit-identical regardless of worker count and completion order (worker_count_invariance); the same plan drives both runs of the two-run determinism check

separate_reporting.principle: the three gate reports are separate artifacts and MUST NOT be merged into a single overall rejection gate

reports.content: per-stratum and overall IID rejection rates vs the frozen threshold 0.50, computed from the AMENDMENT_03 allocator ledger; verdict PASS/FAIL; FAIL => STOP
per OOD condition: consumed / accepted / rejected counts and disposition breakdown (ACCEPT, SUPPORT_BOUND-target-miss, GUARD_BAND, NO_TARGET, STRESS_SET, FAILED_*, other frozen classes)
per OOD condition: quota required vs quota filled, and whether the frozen block was exhausted; verdict PASS/FAIL under gates G1+G2

separate_reporting.merge_ban: no combined 'overall rejection gate' spanning IID and OOD is permitted; OOD proposal-efficiency numbers MUST NOT be pooled into any binding gate verdict
